backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing access control, user profiles, file storage registry, blog posts with view counters, Instagram feed, shop products, newsletter subscriptions, and HTTP outcalls for external API integration.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend component files, describing their functionality including blog, shop, admin, quiz, and upload components with multi-language support.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore file excluding node_modules, build outputs, environment files, IDE configs, OS files, deploy logs (except .gitkeep), and temporary files.
frontend/deploy-logs/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to ensure the deploy-logs directory is tracked by git.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Travel Butts website with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/deploy.ts: Deployment orchestration script that runs backend binding generation, frontend build, and canister deployment with automatic retry logic for transient failures and detailed failure logging with redaction.
frontend/scripts/deploySteps.ts: Utility module for running deployment steps as child processes with stdout/stderr capture and transient failure detection based on network error patterns.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Documentation for deployment scripts describing reliable, rerunnable deployment workflow with automatic retry and diagnostics.
frontend/scripts/redaction.ts: Security utility that redacts sensitive data from logs including API keys, bearer tokens, PEM blocks, principal IDs, emails, and URLs with credentials.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with LanguageProvider, routing logic for all pages (home, admin, quizzes, shop, blog), authentication state management, and profile setup modal for new users.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal component for creating/editing blog posts with image upload, cover image, dual publishing options (direct or scheduled in Amsterdam timezone), tag input, and timezone conversion utilities.
frontend/src/components/BlogSection.tsx: Displays blog posts and Instagram feed items in tabbed interface with video autoplay, view counts, and admin controls. Handles blog post navigation, Instagram item clicks, and integrates with Internet Identity for admin features.
frontend/src/components/BlogViewModal.ts: Modal component for viewing individual blog posts with metadata (author, dates, tags, categories), view count display, and markdown image rendering. Formats timestamps and renders post content with responsive styling.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form section with submission handling via backend mutation, displaying contact information (email, phone, location) and form fields with consent checkbox. Converts form data to ContactSubmission type with nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with brand description, quick navigation links (home, blog, shop, contact), social media links (Instagram, TikTok, Buy Me a Coffee), and internationalization support. Uses hash-based navigation with page reloads.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation, language selector, login button, and admin access control. Features travel tools dropdown, periodic logo refresh, and hash-based navigation with Internet Identity integration.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageUploade: Admin component for uploading and managing the hero image on the homepage, with file validation (JPG/PNG/WebP/SVG, max 10MB), preview functionality, and status feedback.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Main hero section component that displays the hero image and travel tools grid with responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile, including admin upload controls and periodic image refresh.
frontend/src/components/InstagramFeedMan: Admin interface for managing Instagram feed items with support for uploading images/videos (max 50MB for video, 10MB for images), editing captions and links, and CRUD operations.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component for selecting the site language from five options (English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish) with flag icons and click-outside-to-close functionality.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/LogoUploader.tsx: Admin component for uploading and updating the site logo with file validation (JPG/PNG/WebP/SVG, max 10MB), preview of current logo, and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/PackingListManag: Admin interface for managing packing list categories and items with default data structure including clothing, footwear, and toiletries with subcategories for gender-specific items.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal component for initial user profile setup with form validation for name/email, newsletter opt-in, and language selection. Saves profile data via mutation hook and displays validation errors inline.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizActionB: Reusable button component for quiz actions with icon support and multiple style variants (primary, secondary, gradient, brand-primary, brand-secondary).
frontend/src/components/quiz/quizBrandVa: Centralized style configuration object defining consistent brand color variants for buttons, options, cards, progress bars, and animations across quiz components.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizCard.ts: Container card component for quiz content with white or brand color variants and optional fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizOptionB: Quiz answer option button with visual feedback states (selected, correct, incorrect) and brand styling variants.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizPage.ts: Page wrapper component for quiz layouts with centered max-width container and optional brand styling.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizProgres: Progress bar component showing current question number and completion percentage with brand color variants and animation support.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizResultS: Container component for displaying quiz results with white or brand background variants and optional animation.
frontend/src/components/QuizManager.tsx: Admin interface for managing two quiz types: geography quizzes (flags/capitals) and travel style personality quizzes with archetypes. Includes mock data structures and icons for quiz management features.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductManag: Admin component for CRUD operations on shop products with image upload functionality, price formatting, and product status management (published/popular). Handles multiple image uploads with validation and displays product list with edit/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductModal: Modal form for creating/editing shop products with fields for title, description, price, affiliate link, and multiple image uploads. Validates required fields and uploads images to blob storage before submission.
frontend/src/components/ShopSection.tsx: Public-facing shop section displaying popular products in a grid with product detail modal, image carousel, and affiliate link integration. Includes admin controls for adding products and supports internationalized date/price formatting.
frontend/src/components/ToastContainer.t: Toast notification container that subscribes to the toast manager and renders styled notification messages with icons (success/error/warning/info) and dismiss functionality.
Displays a responsive grid of travel tool cards (Trip Randomizer, Shop, Train vs Flight, Packing List, Geography Quiz, Travel Style Quiz) with different layouts for desktop (2 columns), tablet (3 columns), and mobile (2 columns).
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Admin component for managing users, displaying user profiles with principals, roles (admin/user), and newsletter subscription status, with functionality to assign roles and copy user information to clipboard.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: React context providing multi-language support (en, nl, de, fr, es) with localStorage persistence and comprehensive translation dictionary for UI strings across navigation, tools, blog, shop, and quiz sections.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/ge: Contains a database of destinations mapped to travel archetypes (Thrill Seeker, Culture Connoisseur, Chill Escapist, etc.) and exports a function to retrieve ideal destinations based on primary and secondary archetypes.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/id: Defines TypeScript interfaces for Destination (with id, name, description, tags, imageUrl) and DestinationsResponse (with destinations array, loading state, and error).
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/pa: Provides packing list recommendations (essentials, what you need, often forgotten items) tailored to each travel archetype, with a function that returns a PackingListTeaser based on primary and optional secondary archetype.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/pe: Generates personality profiles for each travel archetype with bullet points describing travel values/behaviors and a callout summary, exported via getPersonalityProfile function.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/us: React hook that memoizes and returns ideal destinations for given travel archetypes using getIdealDestinations, wrapping the result in a DestinationsResponse with loading and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including admin checks, user profile management, user listing, blog posts, contact submissions, email captures, settings, Instagram feed, and shop products with mutations for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind CSS, defines custom color palette CSS variables (primary, secondary, accent, neutral), and includes custom utility classes for animations, scrollbars, hover effects, and responsive design.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Comprehensive admin dashboard component with tabs for managing blog posts, contacts, users, media, Instagram feed, shop products, quizzes, packing lists, and site settings. Includes CRUD operations for blog posts, file uploads, and admin settings management.
frontend/src/pages/BlogDetailPage.tsx: Blog post detail page that displays a single blog post with metadata (date, author, tags, view count), renders markdown content with images, increments view count on load, and includes share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Paginated blog listing page that displays published blog posts in a grid with 12 posts per page, shows view counts, and includes navigation controls for browsing through pages.
frontend/src/pages/GeographyQuiz.tsx: Interactive geography quiz component featuring flag and capital city questions for countries worldwide, with score tracking, Instagram story generation for sharing results, and quiz progress visualization.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component that composes HeroSection, BlogSection, ShopSection, and ContactSection with alternating background colors and passes blog click handler to BlogSection.
frontend/src/pages/PackingList.tsx: Interactive packing list page with categorized items (clothing, footwear, toiletries, electronics, documents, etc.), custom item support, search/filter functionality, and PDF export capability.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Shop page displaying published affiliate products with image galleries, search/sort functionality, price formatting, and external purchase links.
frontend/src/pages/TrainVsFlightPrices.t: Comparison tool for train vs flight options showing mock data for routes, prices, durations, and travel time differences with airline/train company images.
frontend/src/pages/TravelStyleQuiz.tsx: Interactive quiz determining user travel archetypes (Thrill Seeker, Culture Connoisseur, etc.) with personality profiles, packing list teasers, ideal destinations, and Instagram story generation.
frontend/src/pages/TripRandomizer.tsx: Random trip generator displaying mock flight and hotel combinations with pricing, amenities, destination highlights, and image galleries for spontaneous travel planning.
frontend/src/utils/instagramStoryGenerat: Generates Instagram Story images (1080x1920) for quiz results with customizable backgrounds, logos, text, and decorative elements using HTML5 Canvas API. Supports gradient, pattern, solid, and custom image backgrounds with Travel Butts brand colors.
frontend/src/utils/toast.ts: Implements a toast notification manager with subscribe/notify pattern for displaying temporary messages with different types (success, error, info, warning) and auto-dismiss functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, sidebar colors, chart colors, border radius variables, custom animations (accordion), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata indicating pending tasks to build Draft Version 133 codebase and deploy to Internet Computer network, with no existing features or known issues documented.
